pages.text: Wants a room: walls, a floor and a ceiling, with no way out to the sky. At least 27 blocks of space.$(p)Grants:$(li)healing, growing with the tier, up to +30%%.$(p)Tiers begin at a score of 6.

pages.text: None of this is required, but building it well earns more than the blocks alone:$(li)Bed is beside wall, and light is 1-5 from bed, and storage is within 6 of bed.
